title: Solos debuts an even lighter version of its camera-less smart glasses
brief: Solos announced the AirGo A6, a camera-free smart glasses device weighing approximately 19 grams—about half the weight of its predecessor (A5) and lighter than Meta's recently announced smart glasses. The AirGo A6 relies on voice-based AI interactions and will support prescription lens compatibility, positioning itself as a lightweight alternative in the smart glasses market.
